title: Famicom Mini 20 - Ganbare Goemon! - Karakuri Douchuu (Japan)

magic_signatures.description: 8-byte Nintendo GBA NES-wrapper boot stamp (rom[0xC0..0xC8], tag 'OEMO') at EEPROM block 0x1F (rev8-logical 0x0F8..0x0FF).

fields.name: slot_0_build_timestamp
fields.description: Slot 0 4-byte BCD build timestamp (MMDDHHmm) copied from ROM header 0x080000C0..0x080000C3.
fields.evidence: VRAM emulator save builder copies 12 bytes from 0x080000C0 into slot 0 (EEPROM block 0x00, rev8-logical 0x000) and verifies them on load.

fields.name: slot_0_build_tag
fields.description: Slot 0 8-byte ASCII build tag ('OEMON1_5') copied from ROM header 0x080000C4..0x080000CB.
fields.evidence: VRAM emulator save builder copies 12 bytes from 0x080000C0 into slot 0 (rev8-logical 0x004..0x00B).

fields.name: slot_0_format_version
fields.description: Slot 0 EEPROM wrapper record format version (always 0x02).
fields.evidence: VRAM emulator writes constant 0x02 to header+0x0C (rev8-logical 0x00C) and rejects records where byte 0x0C != 0x02.

fields.name: slot_0_seq_toggle
fields.description: Slot 0 A/B ping-pong commit toggle (0 or 1, inverted on each save commit).
fields.evidence: VRAM emulator toggles header+0x0D via XOR 1 on each commit (rev8-logical 0x00D) and selects the active slot between block 0x00 and block 0x20.

fields.name: slot_0_crc16
fields.description: Slot 0 reflected CRC-16 (poly=0xD0A2, init=0, +1 trailing zero u32) over 0x18 bytes with header+0x0E..0x0F zeroed.
fields.evidence: VRAM ARM CRC-16 routine (poly 0xD0A2, subs r1, r1, #4; bpl) computes u16 LE over rev8-logical 0x000..0x018 and stores at 0x00E.

fields.name: slot_0_payload
fields.description: Slot 0 game save payload (8 bytes; total record 0x18 bytes = 3 EEPROM blocks).
fields.evidence: VRAM emulator transfers 3 8-byte EEPROM blocks per slot starting at block 0x00 (rev8-logical 0x010..0x018).

fields.name: boot_stamp
fields.description: 8-byte boot stamp (rom[0xC0..0xC8]) written on first boot at EEPROM block 0x1F.
fields.evidence: VRAM emulator reads/writes 8-byte stamp from 0x080000C0 at EEPROM block 0x1F (rev8-logical 0x0F8..0x0FF).

fields.name: slot_1_build_timestamp
fields.description: Slot 1 4-byte BCD build timestamp (MMDDHHmm) copied from ROM header 0x080000C0..0x080000C3.
fields.evidence: VRAM emulator save builder copies 12 bytes from 0x080000C0 into slot 1 (EEPROM block 0x20, rev8-logical 0x100) and verifies them on load.

fields.name: slot_1_build_tag
fields.description: Slot 1 8-byte ASCII build tag ('OEMON1_5') copied from ROM header 0x080000C4..0x080000CB.
fields.evidence: VRAM emulator save builder copies 12 bytes from 0x080000C0 into slot 1 (rev8-logical 0x104..0x10B).

fields.name: slot_1_format_version
fields.description: Slot 1 EEPROM wrapper record format version (always 0x02).
fields.evidence: VRAM emulator writes constant 0x02 to header+0x0C (rev8-logical 0x10C) and rejects records where byte 0x0C != 0x02.

fields.name: slot_1_seq_toggle
fields.description: Slot 1 A/B ping-pong commit toggle (0 or 1, inverted on each save commit).
fields.evidence: VRAM emulator toggles header+0x0D via XOR 1 on each commit (rev8-logical 0x10D) and selects the active slot between block 0x00 and block 0x20.

fields.name: slot_1_crc16
fields.description: Slot 1 reflected CRC-16 (poly=0xD0A2, init=0, +1 trailing zero u32) over 0x18 bytes with header+0x0E..0x0F zeroed.
fields.evidence: VRAM ARM CRC-16 routine (poly 0xD0A2, subs r1, r1, #4; bpl) computes u16 LE over rev8-logical 0x100..0x118 and stores at 0x10E.

fields.name: slot_1_payload
fields.description: Slot 1 game save payload (8 bytes; total record 0x18 bytes = 3 EEPROM blocks).
fields.evidence: VRAM emulator transfers 3 8-byte EEPROM blocks per slot starting at block 0x20 (rev8-logical 0x110..0x118).
